maintenance_led.reason: Regulated natural gas distribution; revenue is gas delivery and sales to households and businesses, not repair or replacement of owned items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are residential, commercial and industrial gas users paying regulated utility rates, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows via regulated rate base investment in pipelines in Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas; territories came from few past purchases.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated monopoly gas utility serving homes and businesses; customers in its territories cannot easily switch suppliers.
